description: Read the text of a PDF: every span with its page, position, font and span id, optionally filtered by `query` (the same four `match` modes an edit uses) and `pages`, over the `content`, `forms` and `annotations` layers. Paginated: pass the returned `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. Use it before `pdf_edit` to check what a document actually says and to pick the `scope` that selects the match you mean.

file.description: The PDF: an absolute (or ~) local path, which this server uploads for you, an https:// URL the API fetches, or an `f_…` file id from an earlier call.

images.description: Also list the images each page draws (`images[]`: page, name, bbox, pixels) -- what `op: remove_image` takes a box from. (default: false)

name: pdf_find
title: Read the text of a PDF
